description: Parses an international phone number (E.164), checks it against Google's open libphonenumber metadata, and returns the country, line type (mobile, fixed line, fixed-or-mobile, VoIP, toll free, premium, pager and more), E.164/international/national formats and the carrier that the number range was originally allocated to. Not a live HLR query: ported numbers keep the original carrier and active/inactive status is not checked. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

number.description: Phone number in international form with country code, e.g. +905321234567 or 00442079460000
